835d8dba729ceff57a8c58adb6921da1c997865a.sourceText: `std::array<T, N>` 是 STL 中封装了固定大小数组的容器模板。它大小在编译时确定，不动态分配内存（在栈上），包装了 C 数组同时提供 STL 容器的标准接口。
835d8dba729ceff57a8c58adb6921da1c997865a.translatedText: `std::array<T, N>` is a container template in the STL that encapsulates a fixed\-size array\. Its size is determined at compile time, it does not dynamically allocate memory (it is on the stack), and it wraps a C array while providing the standard interface of an STL container\.

83b5bf36c5a3e9d7ef0035fedad3690cdb8344ba.sourceText:
* push_back(elem);//在容器尾部加入一个元素
* pop_back();//删除容器中最后一个元素
* push_front(elem);//在容器开头插入一个元素
* pop_front();//从容器开头移除第一个元素
* insert(pos,elem);//在pos位置插elem元素的拷贝，返回新数据的位置。
* insert(pos,n,elem);//在pos位置插入n个elem数据，无返回值。
* insert(pos,beg,end);//在pos位置插入[beg,end)区间的数据，无返回值。
* clear();//移除容器的所有数据
* erase(beg,end);//删除[beg,end)区间的数据，返回下一个数据的位置。
* erase(pos);//删除pos位置的数据，返回下一个数据的位置。
* remove(elem);//删除容器中所有与elem值匹配的元素。
83b5bf36c5a3e9d7ef0035fedad3690cdb8344ba.translatedText:
* push_back(elem);//Add an element at the end of the container
* pop_back();//Remove the last element in the container
* push_front(elem);//Insert an element at the beginning of the container
* pop_front();//Remove the first element from the beginning of the container
* insert(pos,elem);//Insert a copy of the elem element at position pos, and return the position of the new data\.
* insert(pos,n,elem);//Insert n elem data at position pos, with no return value\.
* insert(pos,beg,end);//Insert the data in the range \[beg,end) at position pos, with no return value\.
* clear();//Remove all data from the container
* erase(beg,end);//Delete the data in the range \[beg,end), and return the position of the next data\.
* erase(pos);//Delete the data at position pos, and return the position of the next data\.
* remove(elem);//Delete all elements in the container that match the value elem\.

83cd71ff2795a58c9e09e79833eee14f2614ba8f.sourceText: 这对应源码的一个来源假设：PCD基准是初始 `lidar_odom`，用初始底盘与雷达关系把地图转换到所需参考中。但当前Point-LIO实际保存的是 `camera_init` 下的配准世界点，且其位姿原点涉及内部IMU；不是每一帧的雷达自身坐标。把这类PCD当初始雷达系直接套机械变换，是否与实际建图基准一致，必须复核，不能仅照README的命名认定转换正确。
83cd71ff2795a58c9e09e79833eee14f2614ba8f.translatedText: This corresponds to a source assumption in the code: the PCD baseline is the initial `lidar_odom`, and the map is transformed into the desired reference using the initial chassis\-to\-lidar relationship\. However, the current Point-LIO actually stores registered world points under `camera_init` and its pose origin involves the internal IMU; it is not the lidar's own coordinate frame for each frame\. Whether treating such PCDs as the initial lidar frame and directly applying the mechanical transform is consistent with the actual mapping baseline must be re\-verified; one must not assume the conversion is correct solely based on the README naming\.
